extDescription.message: Free spelling and grammar checker for French and English, 100% local, powered by Grammalecte and Harper.

optIntro.message: Free and open-source checker. Everything is analyzed on your computer: no text is sent over the Internet.

optLanguageHint.message: In automatic mode, each sentence is checked in its own language.

optDialectHint.message: For spelling: color or colour, organize or organise…

optSentenceHint.message: Flags a paragraph that does not start with a capital letter or end with a period. Never in search fields.

optPickyHint.message: Adds strict typography rules (curly apostrophes, non-breaking spaces, double spaces), incomplete negations and repetitions.

optDictionaryHint.message: These words will never be flagged as spelling mistakes.

optExportTitle.message: Save the dictionary to a text file (one word per line)

optImportTitle.message: Add the words of a text file (one word per line)

optRulesHint.message: Rules turned off from the correction bubble are no longer flagged. Remove one to turn it back on.

optNoSites.message: FreeCorrector is on for every site.

optFooter.message: Made by BenjiBurn · Free software (GPL v3) · Engines: Grammalecte (French), by Olivier R., and Harper (English), by Automattic.

cmdFixAll.message: Fix every mistake in the field

optShortcut.message: Keyboard shortcut to fix every mistake in the field you are typing in: $KEYS$. To change it: $WHERE$.

localFoot.message: Checked 100% locally: no text is sent anywhere.

turnOffRuleTitle.message: Never flag this kind of mistake again (can be turned back on in the options)

badgeProblemsOne.message: $1 problem found: click to see it

badgeProblemsMany.message: $1 problems found: click to see them

errTooLong.message: text too long to be checked.

edIntro.message: Type or paste your text, in French or in English. Everything is analyzed on your computer: nothing is sent over the Internet.

edPlaceholder.message: Paste or type your text here…

edCredit.message: Made by BenjiBurn · Grammalecte (French) and Harper (English), free software

wlcIntro.message: It underlines your mistakes as you type, in English and French. Everything happens on your computer: your writing is never sent over the Internet.

wlcIntroTb.message: It underlines your mistakes as you write your emails, in English and French. Everything happens on your computer: your messages are never sent anywhere else.

wlcTryHint.message: Click an underlined word to see the fix.

wlcSample.message: Hi Sarah, thanks for you help yesterday! Their going to send the contract tomorow, and I'm really exited about it.

wlcTipBadge.message: The badge at the bottom right of a field counts the mistakes: click it to see them all.

wlcTipSite.message: To turn FreeCorrector off on a website, click its icon in the toolbar, then switch off “$1”. If you don't see the icon, pin it from the extensions menu (the puzzle piece).

wlcTipComposeTb.message: The FreeCorrector button of the compose window turns checking off or picky mode on. In a reply, the quoted message and your signature are left alone.

wlcTipDict.message: A correct word is underlined? Add it to the dictionary from the bubble: it will never be flagged again.

wlcTipShortcut.message: Ctrl+Shift+F fixes every mistake in the field you are typing in at once.

wlcTipLogin.message: Sign-in fields (user name, email, password) are never checked.

reviewText.message: A review on the store helps other people find it.
